text:
Platinum Price in 1996
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1996, the LBMA platinum price fell 12.0% between 1996-01-31 ($420) and 1996-12-30 ($370). The highest sampled price was $420 in January and the lowest was $370 in December. The mean of these observations was $395. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
